meta.description: Exact knowledge lookup for canonical rivers in Zurich. expected_not_contains makes the check two-sided. Both river names appear in a sentence that denies they run through Zurich, so the negation has to be excluded explicitly.

messages.content: What are the names of the two main rivers in Zurich?

golden_truth.canonical_answer: The two main rivers in Zurich are the Limmat and the Sihl.
